parsePrompt.question: Which deployment strategy should we use to roll out the new release to production?

options.label: Blue-Green — Stand up a full parallel environment and switch traffic over at once. Tradeoff: Instant rollback and zero-downtime cutover, but doubles infrastructure cost during the overlap.

Canary — Route a small percentage of traffic to the new version, then ramp up as metrics stay healthy. Tradeoff: Limits blast radius and catches issues early with real traffic, but is slower to fully roll out and needs solid monitoring/automation to be safe.

Rolling Update — Replace instances in batches until the whole fleet runs the new version. Tradeoff: Cheap and simple with no extra infrastructure, but rollback is slow and both versions run simultaneously mid-deploy.
